decision.selected_method: independent full-task native replay of the saved distributed-structure M1_A schedule

decision.hypothesis: The unresolved physical uncertainty is whether the distributed root-tail structure and its saved M1_A control schedule are genuinely limited by tendon/holding velocity under the complete frozen dynamics, or whether the small violations are artifacts of the finite sampled optimization. Competing hypotheses are: H1, dense independent replay confirms a real dynamic-limit failure near the start of holding, especially tendon channel 2 speed; H2, complete replay remains within all original limits and the sampled diagnostic was conservatively inaccurate. T07-072 found near-threshold position performance but predicted holding speed 0.030581490475219554 m/s against 0.03 m/s and geometric tendon-speed normalized excess 0.04396835416276468, while explicitly leaving independent replay and original acceptance unresolved; T07-071 supplies the current candidate and adapted source lineage.
decision.expected_observation: An independent full 0.0–0.6 s replay from the frozen zero state records every physics state and confirms the diagnostic pattern: position error remains within 0.01 m, but either holding tip speed exceeds 0.03 m/s or at least one tendon speed exceeds 0.025 m/s, with the strongest excess near the 0.54 s holding boundary and likely on channel 2. This would support a real velocity-limited failure and motivate control or damping/routing revision rather than claiming task acceptance.
decision.weakening_observation: The replay completes numerically and satisfies, over the complete physics grid, the original M1_A position and holding-speed thresholds, all four 0–8 N tension bounds, ±0.015 m stroke bounds, and 0.025 m/s tendon-speed bounds. A materially different violation location or failure mode would also weaken the proposed channel-2/holding-transition mechanism and redirect diagnosis.
decision.fixed_conditions: Keep the frozen T07 M1_A task unchanged: target [0.295,0.0,0.215] m, zero qpos/qvel initializer, gravity and payload, 0.6 s duration, 0.001 s timestep, 0.02 s control period, holding window [0.54,0.6] s, position limit 0.01 m, tip-speed limit 0.03 m/s, four independent ideal-tension channels bounded [0,8] N, stroke bounds [-0.015,0.015] m, and tendon-speed limit 0.025 m/s. Use exactly candidate ef5eaf36c890d8157a59de97c5231384915767120dcc714badbee6537cbdd58c and saved schedule 8e005857ed449fe013f0fb469934a19c1f4f7f4f3abc82fb04e25d53d7dfbf9b; do not reoptimize or alter structure, controls, task, or thresholds.
decision.stopping_condition: Stop after this one independent replay is recorded and its complete original acceptance result is available; do not select the candidate unless the exact replay is publicly read and passes. If it fails, retain the failure and return to control/mechanism revision rather than repeating the same replay.
decision.interpretation: This action tests nonlinear full-grid realization only. T07-072 is a finite sampled native-search diagnostic, not independent task acceptance; T07-071 transfers no acceptance. A passing replay would establish M1_A acceptance only, not acceptance of M1_B, M1_C, M5, or the joint T07 task. A failing replay would establish failure of this exact candidate-schedule pair, not structural infeasibility or global control infeasibility.
